text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: The one who brings home the glory today shall be that most first-rate of Umamusume…

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Precisely! As expected of my trainer!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Now I'm off to the red carpet that awaits me—the path of a shining King!
